title: LinkedIn Job Search
description: Searches LinkedIn job listings and returns title, company, location, posted date and a direct link. Uses LinkedIn's public job-search endpoint — the one its own logged-out site calls — so no account, cookie or login is involved and there is nothing that can be restricted. Filter by keywords, location, remote-only and how recently the role was posted.

keywords.description: Job search keywords, e.g. "performance marketing manager".

location.description: Location filter, e.g. "United Kingdom", "India", or "Worldwide". Note this is where the ROLE is based; use remoteOnly to find roles that can be done from elsewhere.

remoteOnly.description: Restrict to roles LinkedIn labels remote. The filter is real — remote and on-site result sets are near-disjoint — but LinkedIn's own labelling is imperfect, so an occasional listing whose title says on-site still comes through.

postedWithinDays.description: Only roles posted within this many days.

maxResults.description: Maximum listings to return. Each page of 25-30 is one request, paced a few seconds apart.

eligibleFrom.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 country code of the candidate, e.g. "IN" for India. When set, roles whose location is limited to other countries or regions are dropped, and each result gains `eligibility` (open/restricted/unknown) with a reason. Use this when "remote" is not enough — a "Remote U.S." role is remote and still closed to someone without US work authorisation.

includeUnknownEligibility.description: Keep roles whose location gives no region at all (a bare "Remote"). On by default: these are the largest group and any restriction is usually buried in the description, so dropping them hides real opportunities. Set false for a stricter, shorter list.
